notes.title: Next update announcement
notes.content:
Hello. This is Sinkersix

In early May, we updated the Season Pass feature along with 5 new songs from Memme, and we appreciate all the feedback we received regarding this update.

Here are some improvements we plan to make regarding the Season Pass update:

1. Season Pass rewards rabalancing
While we designed the Season Pass feature to allow players to obtain items such as new songs, profiles, and hashtags, many users provided feedback that the amount of exp needed to obtain these rewards is too high. In response to the desire for quicker enjoyment of new songs, we has decided to release the songs to Radio Mode freely. Additionally, in future updates, we plan to adjust the specifications so that players can acquire the corresponding rewards upon initial login within the specified period, excluding the current Season Pass reward mechanism.

2. Score/Rank system rebalancing
Regarding the HYPER BRILLIANT judgment, which was previously only available in Survival Mode, many users expressed their wish to have the same detailed judgment in Radio Mode as well. Therefore, we expanded it to Radio Mode in the last patch. VVAV ONE focuses on awarding high scores for accurately processing notes rather than combos. However, we have determined that the weight of HYPER BRILLIANT in the scoring system is set higher than intended. Therefore, in the next patch, we will adjust the score for obtaining HYPER BRILLIANT and the maximum score. Previously, the maximum score for achieving ALL HYPER BRILLIANT was 3,000,000 points, but it will be adjusted to 2,000,000 points in the next patch.

As a token of gratitude for the valuable feedback on the Season Pass update, we will showcase the Green Widow song a bit earlier than originally planned in this update.

Furthermore, as many profiles and hashtags are unlocked at once, we have prepared to change your nickname once in the next update, making it easier for customization. Show off your personality with your new nickname, profile, and hashtags.

We will continue to evolve with our users and strive to become a better VVAV ONE. 
Thank you.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 05/19/24
notes.content:
Hello, this is SinkerSix.

After the previous update, we received the feedback from users and reflected the following in the patch.

1. Unlocked  Memme's new songs in radio mode
-- Please enjoy freely regardless of season pass achievement level.
2. The rank calculation formula based on scores in radio mode has been adjusted.
3. BGM Sync minimum unit adjustment.
-- Previous: 5ms
-- Now: 1ms

Users have left a lot of feedback related to the season pass.
We strive to provide the best experience to our users.
and plan to improve the system accordingly.

Thank you
